findings.desc: concept-cleanup: tier-c-crosshost-quorum-threat-model.md still attributes pinned-key enforcement to M1 (4 residual references at lines 6, 39, 44, 71) after this story redefined M1 to crypto-deferred cross-host review and moved pinned-key work to M-crypto; the phrase "this is the core M1 fix" at line 44 now points at the wrong milestone

concept-cleanup: cross_host_review command calls submitLocalVerdict twice and emits host_verdict process events (L4 evidence-producing), but is missing entries in both command-policy.ts and process-fact-levels.ts — every other evidence-producing command (autopilot_review_submit, quorum_submit) has both entries; without a command-policy entry the access-control tier is undeclared

dispatch-policy: allowReviewOnlyRealHostSubprocess=true un-gates checkDispatchPolicy for codex but lattice-dispatch.ts line 2710 triggers runCodexRealLeafDispatch on allowRealHostSubprocess===true alone — a policy with both flags + allowedHosts=[codex] passes checkDispatchPolicy as authorized, then lattice-dispatch runs the IMPLEMENTATION path; the review-only narrowing is enforced only at the policy-check layer, not at the dispatch-execution layer, defeating the stated narrower-grant intent
